name: @mdvp/cli
description: Design linter for AI-generated frontends: deterministic rendered-DOM audits, CI gates, and MCP design-quality signals

scripts.test: node --test test/color-science.test.mjs test/thresholds.test.mjs test/scorer.test.mjs test/signals.test.mjs test/design-spec.test.mjs test/conflicts.test.mjs test/source-label.test.mjs test/audit-flags.test.mjs test/init.test.mjs test/mcp-version.test.mjs test/badge.test.mjs test/diff.test.mjs test/local-audit-timeout.test.mjs test/adoption-surface.test.mjs test/benchmark-evidence.test.mjs
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const {execSync:e}=require('child_process'); e('git add package.json package-lock.json'); e('git commit -m "chore: release v'+v+'"'); e('git tag v'+v); console.log('Created tag v'+v+'. Push with: git push && git push --tags')"
